g.text: Do you have a moment? I’m a bit upset about something and I could use a friendly ear. Or maybe a bit of a telling off. I’m not sure yet.
Because Kaya says I am. And I had one of those ‘oh shit’ moments when you look back on all the conversations you’ve had with someone and you suddenly see yourself in a new light.
I think I know what she meant, yeah. Sorry, but she's right.
Yes. She just dropped it into the middle of a chat we were having. 'You're cool but you're a minefield. I never know how you're going to react to anything.'
Glad to hear it. Thank you.
I'm glad Kaya called you out on it. I've said things here I thought were harmless and you've reacted like I set your hair on fire.
You have really extreme reactions sometimes. They're out of proportion to what I've said to you.
It's like you leap straight to the worst possible interpretation of what I might have meant.
Sometimes you just quit the conversation entirely and I don't even get a chance to explain myself.
Right now I feel like logging the hell off and never using KIM again.
Maybe think about what you just said there?
I think you need some time to think about that. [END.]
I'm telepathic. Didn't ask to be. But I am. I pick up on thoughts.
If we're talking face to face then I have all sorts of cues that tell me what you're feeling
expression, body language, and hey sometimes an actual THOUGHT because, like I said, TELEPATH
but here on KIM I have to guess and there are no clues
and so yes, I kneejerk sometimes.
(deep breath, sit up straight, get it together Eleanor)
I will try my best not to be a minefield in future.
And I'll have a look back through our old chats and have a good long think.
I owe you that. Because minefield or not, you're still here. You kept walking. x
